1.title: Import, the State CLI and Logging
1.text: Welcome to Module fifteen: Import, the State C L I and Logging. It covers the exam area seven. Maintain infrastructure with Terraform. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. seven A Import existing infrastructure into your Terraform workspace. seven B Use the C L I to inspect state. seven C Describe when and how to use verbose logging. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: seven. Maintain infrastructure with Terraform. Exam format: a one-hour online-proctored multiple-choice exam on Terraform one point one two. Validated against: the official Terraform Associate version oh oh four exam objectives.

1.title: Importing existing infrastructure
1.text: Importing existing infrastructure. Import brings an existing real resource under Terraform's management by adding it to the state. Import does not write the configuration for you by default.

1.title: Importing existing infrastructure, continued
1.text: Importing existing infrastructure. The figure shows this: Import connects a real resource to a resource block in the state.

1.title: Importing existing infrastructure, continued
1.text: Importing existing infrastructure. import block (Terraform one point five and later, preferred). Declare to (the resource address) and id (the real object's I D) in configuration. terraform import command (older). terraform import aws instance dot web I N S T A N C E I D.

1.title: Importing existing infrastructure, continued
1.text: Importing existing infrastructure. The example is on the screen; read it line by line when you study.

1.title: Importing existing infrastructure, continued
1.text: Importing existing infrastructure. Two parts. The resource block (configuration) and the state entry (import). Generate configuration. terraform plan -generate config out generated dot tf can write the resource block for import blocks. With import blocks. Reviewed in plan and applied with apply like any change. With the command. The state changes immediately; you must write the matching resource block yourself. The id. Depends on the resource type (see the provider documentation). Exam tip: Import fills the state, not the configuration (unless you generate it). After an import, plan should show no changes if your configuration matches.

1.title: Inspecting state with the CLI
1.text: Inspecting state with the C L I. The terraform state command reads and changes state safely. Never edit the state file by hand. terraform state list. Lists resource addresses in the state. terraform state show A D D R E S S. Shows the attributes of one resource. terraform state mv S O U R C E D E S T. Moves an item to a new address. terraform state rm A D D R E S S. Removes an item from state without destroying the real object. terraform state pull. Prints the raw state (Jason). terraform state push. Uploads a state file (rare and risky). terraform show. Human-readable view of the whole state or a saved plan. terraform output. Shows output values. Exam tip: state list shows what exists, state show shows one resource, state rm forgets without destroying.

1.title: Verbose logging
1.text: Verbose logging. Terraform writes detailed logs when you set environment variables. T F L O G. Sets the level: T R A C E (most detail), D E B U G, I N F O, W A R N, error. T F L O G P A T H. Writes the log to a file instead of the screen. T F L O G C O R E, T F L O G P R O V I D E R. Separate levels for Terraform core and for providers.

1.title: Verbose logging, continued
1.text: Verbose logging. The example is on the screen; read it line by line when you study.

1.title: Verbose logging, continued
1.text: Verbose logging. A provider error is unclear. See the A P I calls. Terraform seems to hang. See where it waits. Reporting a bug. Attach the log (after removing secrets). Logs can contain sensitive data, so treat them like secrets. Unset T F L O G when finished. Exam tip: T F L O G T R A C E is the most verbose. Use T F L O G P A T H to save the log to a file.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A team has a manually created instance and wants Terraform to manage it from now on. What does import do? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Adds the existing object to the state. Import adds the existing real object to the state so Terraform can manage it.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. With the older terraform import command, what must the user also provide? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: A matching resource block in the configuration. The command only changes the state; the matching resource block must be written by the user.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which feature can write a resource block for an import block automatically? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: terraform plan -generate-config-out. The -generate-config-out option can generate configuration for import blocks.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which command lists every resource address in the state? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: terraform state list. terraform state list prints the addresses of the resources in the state.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. Which command removes a resource from state without destroying the real object? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: terraform state rm. terraform state rm removes the item from state and leaves the real resource running.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which setting writes detailed debug information to a file? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: T F L O G P A T H with a file name, with T F L O G set to a level. T F L O G sets the level and T F L O G P A T H sends the log to a file.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What does import add? Answer: An existing real object to the state. Question two. What are the two arguments of an import block? Answer: to and id. Question three. Which command shows one resource's attributes? Answer: terraform state show.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Which log level is the most detailed? Answer: T R A C E. Question five. Which variable saves the log to a file? Answer: T F L O G P A T H. Question six. Can logs contain secrets? Answer: Yes, so treat them as sensitive.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Import: adds the object to state; import block (to, id) or terraform import; -generate-config-out. State C L I: list, show, mv, rm, pull; terraform show; never edit by hand. Logging: T F L O G (T R A C E to error), T F L O G P A T H, T F L O G C O R E, T F L O G P R O V I D E R.
